standard: Every action benefiting a named private party (contracts, purchases, renewals, change orders, piggybacks, zoning/land use/variances/plats/site plans/development agreements, leases and sales of public land, grants and fee waivers to named organizations, settlements, easements, licenses). Excludes proclamations, ceremonial items, appointments, internal staffing, government-only items. Built without reference to donors.

gaps.issue: Tenure extension (Oct 25, 2026): Duncan took Seat 1 in Nov 2018 and Lord took Seat 2 after the Dec 1, 2020 runoff. eSCRIBE lists minutes for Nov 5, 2018 through Oct 28, 2020 only as PDF files (FileStream.ashx), which return a browser-verification page to scripts and WebFetch; the town clerk page says older records are by request (townclerk@cutlerbay-fl.gov). Council meetings in this span not read: 2018-11-05, 2018-12-12, 2019-01-16, 2019-02-20, 2019-03-20, 2019-04-17, 2019-05-15, 2019-06-19, 2019-07-17, 2019-07-29, 2019-09-10, 2019-09-18, 2019-09-24, 2019-10-16, 2019-11-13, 2019-11-20, 2020-01-15, 2020-02-19, 2020-03-04, 2020-04-22, 2020-05-20, 2020-06-17, 2020-07-15, 2020-07-29, 2020-08-26, 2020-09-08, 2020-09-16, 2020-09-22, 2020-09-24, 2020-10-15, 2020-10-28 (Mar 18, 2020 has no minutes posted). Lord was not seated until Dec 2020, so her tenure gap is the Dec 2020 meeting only (none listed in eSCRIBE).
2021-2024 actions were read from the eSCRIBE HTML minutes (Jan 20, 2021 to Dec 4, 2024). Roger Coriat held Seat 3 until Ramirez was sworn in on Nov 28, 2022; his votes are in the Coriat column.

2021-2024 excluded under the standard: FDLE, FDEP, FDOT, Alliance for Aging, Children's Trust, Florida Communities Trust and NEAT Streets grant acceptances; interlocals with Miami-Dade County; opioid MOUs; town-only land use changes (18551 Old Cutler Road, folio 36-6003-001-0013) and comprehensive plan text amendments; land acquisition bond ordinance and intent resolutions (the bond award to TD Public Finance is listed); deferrals (Ross Stores sign variance, later withdrawn; Chabad of Homestead Sep 21, 2022; Southplace plats Sep 24, 2024), which are listed at the meeting where they were decided
Minutes record mover, seconder and "Passed" but no member-by-member vote; all five members attended. Same for 2023-01-18 items 11.a-11.b and 2023-06-21
Regular meeting held but minutes not yet posted; private-party agenda items listed with roll null
eSCRIBE minutes record mover, seconder and "Passed" for each motion but no member-by-member vote; roll and tally null (all five members attended)
Special meeting minutes record no member votes; the only action (Legacy Park master plan revision) is town-only and was deferred
Cutler Bay Community Fund grant resolutions name the dollar total but not the not-for-profit recipients; recipients are in the attached exhibits, which were not opened
Consent items carry the single consent-agenda vote, which eSCRIBE repeats under each consent item
Absent members are marked absent from the attendance block in each set of minutes
Workshops, zoning workshops and budget hearings were read; workshops take no votes

Excluded under the standard: interlocal agreements with Miami-Dade County and FDOT, state and federal grant acceptances, RFP/ITB issuances naming no vendor, code amendments, budgets and town-only brownfield designations (Blue Heron Park, town-owned property)
